Customer.title: Motorbike rental in Bangkok
Customer.intro: Find and book bikes from local rental shops. Search is coming soon.
Customer.metaDescription: Book motorbikes from local rental shops in Bangkok.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.vendorHint: Shop owners and staff: sign in with LINE or Google.
Login.errorSignin: Sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
Login.errorLink: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.
Login.sent: Check your email for a sign-in link. It works once and expires in 1 hour.
Login.sendFailed: Couldn't send the link. Check the address and try again.

Account.title: Your account
Account.name: Name
Account.whatsappNeeded: Add a WhatsApp number to get WhatsApp messages

Join.title: Join a shop team
Join.incomplete: This invite link is incomplete. Ask the shop owner for a new one.
Join.intro: You've been invited to help manage a rental shop's bookings and fleet.
Join.expired: This invite has expired or was already used. Ask the shop owner for a new link.

Vendor.title: Vendor dashboard
Vendor.intro: Manage your bikes, prices and bookings here. Coming soon.
Vendor.createShopIntro: You're not part of a shop yet. Create your shop below, or if you work at a shop, ask the owner for an invite link.

Admin.title: Admin panel
Admin.intro: Approve shops, manage rankings and finance. Coming soon.

Common.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

Errors.url: Enter a full link starting with https://.
Errors.closeAfterOpen: Closing time must be after opening time.
Errors.endAfterStart: The end must be on or after the start.
Errors.termsRequired: Tick the box to accept the vendor terms.
Errors.notReady: Some setup steps are still missing (see the checklist).
Errors.hasBookings: This model has bookings, so it can't be deleted. Untick "Show to customers" to hide it instead.
Errors.afterThirtyRequired: The price per day after 30 days is required.
Errors.splitTooBig: Instant and Request together can't be more than the quantity.
Errors.repairTooBig: That's more bikes than are in service.

Home.pendingNote: Thanks! We're checking your shop. You can keep editing; changes save as usual.
Home.suspendedNote: Your shop is suspended and hidden from customers. Contact the platform team.

check.about: About your shop (at least a couple of sentences)
check.model_photo: A photo for every bike model

Home.ownerSubmits: The shop owner submits the shop for review.
Home.term2: Price parity: never charge customers more at the counter than the website shows.
Home.term3: Keep Ready today and down time accurate.
Home.term4: Reply to requests and delivery approvals within the response window.
Home.liveNote: Your shop is live. Customers will see your bikes once search opens.
Home.flaggedNote: Recent changes are live and waiting for a routine check by the platform team.
Home.submitEarlyHint: You can submit now and finish the rest later. Your shop goes live once everything on the checklist is done and we've approved it.

Settings.title: Shop settings
Settings.name: Shop name
Settings.aboutHint: What makes your shop good to rent from. English is best: customers are visitors.
Settings.locationHint: Customers use this to find you. Pick your Google Business Profile to also show your Google rating and reviews later.
Settings.hoursHint: Pickups and returns are only possible during these hours.
Settings.repeatsYearlyHint: For holidays on the same dates each year, like Songkran. Holidays that move each year need adding each year.
Settings.contactsHint: Shown to a customer only after their booking is confirmed.
Settings.defaultsIntro: The rules and inclusions every bike starts from. Each bike model can change any of them.
Settings.requestWindowHint: Minutes, up to 240 (4 hours). Counts during opening hours only.
Settings.noticeHint: Hours before pickup, e.g. 24 to have time to wash and check bikes. Does not apply to ready walk-ins.

Location.search: Find your shop on Google Maps
Location.searchHint: Type your shop's name or address and pick it. You can then drag the pin.
Location.map: Map. Click or drag the pin to set your shop's location.
Location.mapFailed: The map couldn't load. Enter the coordinates instead.
Location.stationHint: Suggested from the pin. Edit if needed.

Photos.requirements: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to {max} photos · resized automatically to {edge} px

problem.heic: iPhone HEIC photo, which this browser can't open. Save it as JPG first, or set the iPhone camera to Most Compatible (Settings → Camera → Formats).
problem.notImage: not a photo. Use JPG, PNG or WebP.
problem.unreadable: couldn't be opened. Try saving it as JPG.
problem.tooLarge: still over 5 MB after resizing. Try a smaller photo.
problem.permission: you don't have permission to add photos here. Sign in again as the shop's owner or staff.
problem.failed: upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

Included.title: What's included, deposit and documents
Included.intro: Your shop defaults. Customers compare these between shops. Each bike model can override any of them.
Included.thirdPartyAlways: Compulsory third-party insurance is always included.
Included.damageCoverNote: Damage/theft cover isn't listed here. If you offer it, add it as an extra with its terms.
Included.depositAmountHint: Blank = no money deposit. Each bike model can set its own amount.
Included.depositAmountOnModel: The deposit amount is set in the model's details above.
Included.notesHint: Anything else, e.g. fuel policy or late return charges.
Included.overrideHelmets: Edit helmet types for this bike

Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.intro: Quantities and today's status. Changes save as soon as you leave a field.
Fleet.empty: No bikes yet. Add your first model.

error.ceiling: Can't be more than qty minus down time.

Fleet.helpQty: How many of this bike your shop owns in total. Open the bike to split them between Instant, Request and walk-ins only.
Fleet.helpReady: For customers who want a bike today ("Get your bike now"). Tick it and enter how many are ready to hand over right now. Each same-day booking takes one off; at 0 it switches to Out. It stays as you set it until you change it.
Fleet.helpDowntime: Bikes that can't be rented, e.g. in repair or waiting for parts. Add an entry for each group with its own back date (optional). Until then they can't be booked at all.
Fleet.repairConflicts: These bookings no longer fit with bikes out of service: {codes}. Shorten the time out of service, or contact the customers.
Fleet.readyHint: (removes advanced notice requirement allowing for customers to rent immediately)

NewModel.title: Add a bike model
NewModel.intro: Pick the model from the catalog. You set your own quantity, prices, deposit and photos next.
NewModel.addFailed: Couldn't add that model. Please try again.
NewModel.results: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}
NewModel.requestIntro: Request it. You can set it up straight away; customers see it once the platform team approves it.

Model.photos: Your photos of this bike (at least one)
Model.visibleHint: Untick to hide this model without deleting it.
Model.includedHint: Starts on your shop defaults. Change only what's different for this model.
Model.noExtras: No extras apply to this model.
Model.deleteHint: Removes this model and its prices and photos. Models with bookings can only be hidden.
Model.deleteConfirm: Delete this model? This can't be undone.
Model.split: How these bikes can be booked
Model.splitHint: Select how many bikes you would like to allocate for each booking type.
Model.modeInstantHint: Booked in advance and confirmed automatically.
Model.modeRequestHint: Booked in advance; you accept or decline each one.
Model.modeWalkinOnlyHint: Never booked in advance; rented only when ready for walk-ins.
Model.noticeHint: Does not apply to ready walk-ins.
Model.alreadyInFleet: This bike is already in your fleet, so we opened it. Change its quantity here instead of adding it again.

Pricing.anchorsHint: Enter the total for 1 and 30 days (and 7, 14, 21 if you like). Days in between fill in automatically; you can change any day.
Pricing.needAnchors: Enter the 1-day and 30-day totals to see the full table.
Pricing.after30Hint: Each day from day 31 costs this much. A further month never costs more than your 30-day price.

Extras.title: Extras
Extras.intro: Paid add-ons customers can tick when booking, e.g. damage/theft cover or use outside Bangkok. They're paid at your shop; the platform fee never applies to extras.
Extras.ownerOnly: Only the shop owner can change extras.
Extras.name: Name
Extras.termsHint: Optional, e.g. the deductible and what isn't covered.
Extras.timeHint: Days in between are charged in equal steps, like bike prices. With only a 1-day price it's that price × days.
Extras.deleteHint: To stop offering it for now, pause it instead.

Team.title: Team
Team.intro: Staff can manage bookings and the fleet, but not shop settings, extras or the team.
Team.inviteIntro: Create a link and send it by LINE or email. It works once and expires in 7 days.
Team.linkOnce: Copy it now: it's only shown once.
Team.shareText: You're invited to help manage {shop}. Open this link and sign in: {link}
